maria (Docs): quick heads-up — opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/452 to clarify how rate tiers apply to embeddings and add a short SDK/cURL example. need 1 reviewer + dashboard owner to confirm a panel rename. @jon (PM) @sam (Eng) :eyes:
jon (PM): thanks — can review tomorrow morning. main question: do we change the UI label from 'Usage Tier' to 'Billing Tier'? that will ripple into product copy and docs.
sam (Eng): i prefer 'Billing Tier' for clarity. also, the SDK snippet should show the quota header. propose short examples for curl + node: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'X-Redwood-Account: acct_123' \
  -H 'X-Redwood-Quota: tier:pro' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"input":"hello world"}'
```
maria (Docs): perfect — i'll add both. also spotted a 404 in the dashboard links section: https://internal.redwood.ai/dashboards/usage (returns 404). @kate (Analytics) can you confirm a redirect or new panel id?
kate (Analytics): yep that's the old path. new public panel is https://dash.redwood.ai/p/ux/usage-overview — i'll set a redirect and add a note in the PR. fyi metric rename last quarter: `ingested_tokens` -> `tokens_ingested`. update any example queries that use the old metric.
maria (Docs): good catch. i'll add a migration note: "If you reference ingested_tokens, rename to tokens_ingested. Example: `sum(tokens_ingested) by tier`"
sam (Eng): LGTM — tiny nit: for the Node snippet use fetch/await and include error handling. i'll paste a quick Node example inline after lunch.
docs-bot: Link check: 1 warning — relative link in /docs/rate-limits.md -> ../pricing (possible redirect)
maria (Docs): thanks bot — i'll fix links and update the snippet. aiming to merge by EOD, unless any objections. :thumbsup:
